LanguageData.LP_GithSeesLich.stages.0.label: glory of the lich
LanguageData.LP_GithSeesLich.stages.0.description: The colony has an undying lich, like the shadow of the lich-queen watching over us.
Mind flayers enslaved my ancestors. Living with one of those things, I want to draw my sword every night.
Descendants of the slaves who escaped, always holding silver swords. The hivemind dislikes them.
